actors.name: Warehouse Worker
actors.description: Processes incoming shipments at the receiving dock

businessGoals.name: Accurate Receiving
businessGoals.description: Track all incoming goods and ensure accuracy against purchase orders

domainConcepts.name: Receiving Note
domainConcepts.description: A record of goods received at the warehouse dock

domainConcepts.name: Received Line
domainConcepts.description: A line item representing a specific SKU and quantity received

domainConcepts.name: Discrepancy
domainConcepts.description: A mismatch between expected and actual received quantity

rules.description: A receiving note must have at least one line before it can be finalized
A finalized receiving note cannot be modified
Discrepancy is the difference between expected quantity and actual received quantity

modules.name: Receiving
modules.description: Handles incoming goods at the warehouse

buildingBlocks.name: ReceivingNote
buildingBlocks.description: Aggregate root tracking goods received at the dock. Contains ReceivedLine entities.

behaviours.name: addLine
behaviours.description: Adds a received line for a SKU

behaviours.name: finalize
behaviours.description: Finalizes the receiving note, locking further changes

buildingBlocks.name: ReceivingNoteId
buildingBlocks.description: Unique identifier for a receiving note

buildingBlocks.name: ReceivedLine
buildingBlocks.description: A line item in a receiving note tracking actual received quantity for a SKU

behaviours.name: discrepancy
behaviours.description: Calculates the discrepancy between expected and actual quantity

buildingBlocks.name: ReceivingFinalized
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when a receiving note is finalized

buildingBlocks.name: FinalizeReceivingHandler
buildingBlocks.description: Orchestrates finalization of a receiving note

behaviours.name: handle
behaviours.description: Loads a receiving note and finalizes it

useCases.name: Finalize Receiving
useCases.description: Worker finalizes a receiving note after counting all goods
